basis: The engineering scope is the AESM repository itself (AI-Assisted-Engineering-System-Model), specifically its repository-local persistence and cross-session PI recovery capability.

evidence.finding: Repository root confirmed at /AI-Assisted-Engineering-System-Model; .aesm/ persistence boundary created by Runtime on PI creation; ProcessStore uses repository_context.aesm_root().

The AESM repository-local persistence root (.aesm/) is created by the Runtime/ProcessStore on first PI creation, not pre-existing. The ProcessStore._dir() layout is <repo-root>/.aesm/<pi-id>/. ProcessStore.create() writes process.json, context.json, and the initial history.jsonl entry atomically. No workspace-level .aesm-process-store/ path is involved in repository-local persistence.
evidence.relevance: This observation establishes the actual persistence mechanics that Session B must rely upon to recover this Process Instance.
evidence.source: direct filesystem and source-code inspection of runtime/core/store.py

recognition.basis: Observation verified by direct inspection of runtime/core/store.py ProcessStore.create() method and filesystem state before and after PI creation.

evidence.finding: Session B independently discovered PI f713278b-cb74-4a49-a6a1-b6713f058b56 from repository-local .aesm/ persistence boundary without any Session A context. Attachment via AgentRuntimeBridge.attach() with Session B Runtime ID 'session-b-bridge' succeeded. Runtime-reported state is consistent with persisted process.json and context.json. This observation constitutes the Session B continuation proof-of-continuity: the same PI is recovered and advanced by a genuinely separate agent session.
evidence.relevance: Demonstrates that AESM Process Instance continuity across independent agent sessions is functional: discovery from .aesm/, recovery via Runtime attach(), and state advancement through a supported bridge operation all succeed.
evidence.source: Session B fresh-agent filesystem inspection and Runtime recovery

recognition.basis: Session B has independently verified: (1) the PI ID was discovered from .aesm/ filesystem without Session A context; (2) Runtime attach() returned authoritative state consistent with persisted process.json and context.json; (3) this observation records the Session B continuation event as governed evidence under the recovered Execution Context.
